Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: Misinterpreted logical equivalences and prematurely declared most biconditionals as tautologies without verification. In particular, the analysis incorrectly treated non-symmetric forms as equivalent (e.g., asserting (A → B) is equivalent to (B → A)), and concluded the odd one out without a systematic check (such as a truth table). This reflects the “Incorrect Logical Derivation/Assertion of Tautology Without Justification” pattern.
